_readme: Weekly missions: one real-life challenge a week, in this order (back to the start after the last one). Nothing to win: ticking one off just marks it done. 'ideas' are a few ways to do it. Edited in the admin area once the app is live.

missions.title: Get outside for 30 minutes
missions.body: Fresh air. Clear head. Real world wins. It doesn't have to be a hike: a walk, a swim at the beach, a kick of the footy, anything counts.
ideas: Walk to the shops instead of driving
Take lunch to the park
A swim, a surf or a paddle

missions.title: Catch up with a mate
missions.body: Time with people who are good for you is one of the best things there is for your head. Face to face is great; a proper phone call counts too.
ideas: Grab a coffee or a feed
Ring someone you haven't spoken to in a while
Watch the footy at a mate's place

missions.title: Cook a proper meal
missions.body: Something from scratch, start to finish. It fills an evening, it's cheaper than takeaway and you get to eat it.
ideas: A barbie for the family
A recipe you've never tried
Cook a double batch and freeze half

missions.title: Have a phone-free evening
missions.body: Put the phone in another room from dinner until bed. Notice how the evening feels without it.
ideas: A board game or cards with the family
Read a book or a magazine
Get an early night

missions.title: Get your heart rate up
missions.body: Twenty minutes of anything that makes you puff. Exercise takes the edge off stress and urges, and you sleep better after it.
ideas: A run or a fast walk
A bike ride
Push-ups and squats in the lounge room

missions.title: Sort out one thing you've been putting off
missions.body: That job that's been hanging over you. Ticking it off clears a bit of mental space.
ideas: Clean out the garage or the car
Make that appointment
Fix the thing that's been broken for ages

missions.title: Try something new
missions.body: New things give your brain something to look forward to. Small counts: it just has to be new to you.
ideas: A class or a club
A new walking track
Learn a song, a trick or a recipe

missions.title: Do something for someone else
missions.body: Helping someone out is good for them and good for you. No need for anything big.
ideas: Mow a neighbour's lawn
Help a mate move
Cook for someone who's doing it tough

missions.title: Watch a sunrise or a sunset
missions.body: Ten minutes, no phone, just watching the sky change. A simple way to slow everything down.
ideas: From the beach or a lookout
From the backyard with a cuppa
On the way home from work

missions.title: Three early nights
missions.body: Being tired makes urges louder. Aim for three nights this week in bed with the lights off by 10:30.
ideas: Phone on charge outside the bedroom
No screens for the last half hour
Same bedtime each night
